Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.pages

Class PageRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.pages.PageRenderer
@Component public class PageRenderer extends Object
Renders a server-rendered page (a Thymeleaf template) to the text/html answer of an operation generated from the pages contract. The view is resolved through the application's view resolvers, in their order, with the locale of the request, and rendered against the current request into a wrapper that captures what it writes, so everything a template relies on keeps working: the CSRF hidden field that th:action adds, @{...} links and the messages. Every page gets the branding as the "branding" model attribute.

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> render(String viewName, Map<String,?> model)
      Renders a page.
      Parameters:
      viewName - name of the view (the Thymeleaf template).
      model - model attributes of the page; the branding is added to them.
      Returns:
      a 200 with the page as text/html.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no view resolver knows the view, or the view cannot be rendered.
